digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 LLM plan-review chunk and agent pool
propositions: Cold-cache Pass-1 submission incurs N redundant cache-WRITE operations for the byte-identical plan-bearing system prefix when all chunks/agents are submitted concurrently to the pool
Warm-then-fan-out pattern (proven for container bins) can reduce cache writes from N to 1 by running the first chunk serially to completion before fanning out the remainder to the pool
The warm-gate fires when estimated shared-prefix tokens exceed CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS threshold and there are 2+ Pass-1 calls; non-systemic warm failures degrade gracefully to direct fan-out
Per-call cache metrics verify that the warmed path incurs exactly one cache-WRITE for the shared prefix and N-1 cache-READs for subsequent calls
